system.effect: Grows one duplicate creature from a piece of the original creature
system.description: Duration: Permanent Effect: Grows one duplicate creature from a piece of the original creature A clone is an exact duplicate of another living creature, grown from a piece of the original through the use of this spell. The piece need not be alive at the time the spell is cast. A human or demihuman clone is rare and may be very dangerous. A clone of any other living creature is a more common thing called a simulacrum. A character can have only one clone at a time; attempts at making multiple clones of a single character automatically fail. Undead and constructs cannot be cloned, because they are not living creatures.
